a: Write a short imperative subject: Fix rate limit on chat endpoint.
git branch name creates a branch; git switch name checks it out.
git merge branch combines that branch into the current one.
Rebase replays commits on top of another base for a linear history.
git stash temporarily shelves uncommitted changes.
Cherry-pick applies a specific commit onto the current branch.
Tags mark releases; annotated tags store message and author.
.gitignore lists files Git should not track.
Resolve conflicts by editing markers, then add and commit.
Avoid force-pushing to shared main branches; it rewrites history.
